summary: One Metrocount piezo counter, running from Aug 2014 to Sep 2026 with one record per slot and no duplication or halving. A 15 Dec 2023 to 5 Nov 2024 run of zeros is correctly set to missing. Most zero_outage fixes removed real storm or rain lows that the neighbouring Shrimptons Ck counter (site 177) confirms, so they are restored. The level after 2024 is about 10% below late 2023 while site 177 rose, but the hourly profiles and direction split are unchanged, so it is kept as is.
